Huangbo Xiyun owns the retained deployment: meets Nanquan's golden-world question with crossed arms and a stand instead of words, hands Nanquan's own question back when told to ask the old teacher Wang, and draws Chushi Fanqi's ruling that one of the two old worthies made something of nothing and the other took error for error.

Occurrences.Kwic: 佛祖，冷笑衲僧，只知掩鼻偷香，不覺空招罪犯。幸逢聖主，獲覩清光，誤蒙巨霈雲恩，特賜佛海禪號，山川增秀，慧日重輝，御樓前正令全提，金殿上鐘頓覺，亦未曾欠闕，四海不為多，智鑑洞明，心花燦發，西江吸盡，北斗橫身。當恁麼時如何？豈不見僧問投子和尚：如何是十身調御？投子下禪牀叉手而立。只如投子下下禪牀叉手而立，且道是何宗旨？無事打鼓普請看。又不見肅宗皇帝問忠國師：如何是十身調御？國師云：檀越蹋毗盧頂上行。帝曰：朕不會。國師云：陛下莫錯認自己清淨法身。大眾，且道清淨法身與十身調御相去多少？若也緇素得出，未免袖頭打領；若也緇素不出，未免腋下剜襟。而今忽有人問靈隱：如何是十身調御？提起袈裟角云：還會麼？此乃貧道向

Xuedou Chongxian owns the retained deployment: seated with the court censor Li and a Daoist scholar, answers which of the three teachings is honored by stepping down from the bench and standing with crossed arms, and to the why-not-say-it replies it is hard to speak before the Master, with the record's verse crowning him who stands sideways with crossed arms alone honored.

Senses.Explanation: The crossed-arm stand as a whole answer, and the masters who gave it, raised it, or read it. Huangbo Xiyun meets Nanquan's golden-world question by crossing his arms and standing, and when told if you cannot say it, why not ask the old teacher Wang, he hands the very question back, drawing Chushi Fanqi's ruling that one of the two old worthies made something out of nothing and the other took error for error, Yangshan Huiji steps forward in the crossed-arm stand to answer Guishan's midwinter question he is known unable to answer, while Xiangyan claims he alone could answer it yet steps forward in the same stand, Lingzhao, asked for her father, sets down the vegetable basket and stands with crossed arms, and when Danxia asks again she picks up the basket and walks off, and Wanfeng Shiwei meets Qianyan's not-mind-not-buddha-not-thing question by striking a circle with his sitting cloth and standing with crossed arms, trading rounds of blind with the master until he is named first seat. Luopu Yuanan arrives at Jiashan without bowing and stands facing him with crossed arms, is told a rooster perched in a phoenix nest is not of its kind, and drinks at the words no novice before me and no old monk here, Touzi Datong answers the question on the ten-body steersman by stepping down from the Chan bench and standing with crossed arms, a doubled gesture Xiatang Huiyuan raises to ask his own assembly what principle it holds before beating the drum and setting everyone to work, and Xuedou Chongxian, seated with the court censor Li and a Daoist scholar, answers which of the three teachings is honored by stepping down from the bench and standing with crossed arms, and to the why-not-say-it replies it is hard to speak before the Master.
